prompt: Use case: product-mockup. A premium photographic category placeholder for BOOKS in Aftertaste, an adult personal cultural diary with luxurious retro art direction. Landscape 3:2, one single closed vintage cloth-bound book photographed from a quiet three-quarter overhead angle on a near-white neutral studio surface. The book is deep cool burgundy with subtly aged cloth, fine ivory page edges and exquisite physical detail, completely blank cover and spine. The object fills about 75% of the image, centred and immediately recognisable at thumbnail size, with comfortable clear margins. Restrained 1970s editorial still-life photography: soft directional window light from upper left, gently dimensional shadow, subtle analogue tonality, precise photographic optics. Palette limited to deep burgundy, charcoal, ivory and silver-grey. The design should look like a real fine object in a private collection, not a children's illustration or a computer-generated toy. No text, title, letters, numbers, logos, brands, decorative lines, olive, green, yellow, gold ornaments, props, hands or extra objects. Background clean and almost white with a mild warm-neutral tone, never parchment or distressed paper. No border or card UI, no watermark.
